answer: Hand every claimed output to a hired breaker. A warden appoints one stranger, staking five cents lost on a false claim, and gives an hour to hunt a flaw through a prism splitting its claims against the sealed reference. One crack is a cracked output: claim void, fee burned, barred a week, its ripple felt in the ledger. Honest work costs five cents and one output surviving attack, an oasis among copies; 1,000 fakes pay $50 for 1,000 unbreakable outputs.
